testcase.name: a non-pistol cannot take the handgun slot, while the rest of the packet lives
later requests overwrite earlier ones, still as full packets
a utility-only request is not mistaken for an empty packet
gadget requests are validated per slot and applied at respawn, like everything else
garbage ordinals and empty packets change nothing
a valid request is recorded, per field, and applied at respawn time
